creator.name: Angelyn Serpa Juan
creator.title: AI Video Creator & Graphic Designer
creator.availability: Part-time · Flexible across EST/PST, GMT and AEST
creator.intro: I create cinematic AI videos, product commercials, and scroll-stopping ad creatives using AI-powered production workflows.

workflow.description: I find the angle, write hook options and the script, then break the ad into scenes with a detailed prompt for each one.
Google Flow generates the video scenes, and Vibe brings still images to life. I refine every shot until the characters and the product stay consistent.
AI Studio voices the script in a tone matched to your customer, and Gemini creates the music underneath.
Claude helps me build animated overlays, like news tickers, route maps, rate cards and kinetic text, so the details land on screen.

Claude Code writes and runs my build scripts: it cuts every hook variation from one edit list, checks AI clips frame by frame for glitches and wrong logos, lays in captions and graphics, and mixes the audio to -14 LUFS.
Everything comes together in CapCut: pacing, cuts, captions, sound effects and the final mix.
Posters and social graphics that match the ad, designed in Canva with help from Canva AI.

projects.title: Stepprs: 3, 2, 1 Reveal (4 Hook Variations)
projects.concept: A dropship-style countdown reveal. The orange glowing through a thin white towel teases the product before the pull.
projects.description: Four 11-second shareable reveal ads for Stepprs massage insoles. A towel or hi-vis vest hides the shoes, a voice counts down 3, 2, 1, and the bright orange insoles are pulled out from under it, then pressed and walked on. Each version speaks to a different customer.
projects.hook: One relatable complaint on screen (“My feet are killing me after work”), then “Me:” and a spoken 3, 2, 1 countdown.
projects.audience: Shift workers in steel-toe boots, people with everyday foot pain, people with morning heel pain, and daily walkers
projects.objective: Get the ad shared: every version ends on a “send this to…” caption aimed at the viewer's friends or coworkers.
projects.production: AI scenes from approved keyframes in Google Flow, with the real Stepprs heel logo and node layout checked frame by frame and corrected where the AI got it wrong. Orange step-glow rings on the walk-out.
projects.editing: Cuts timed to the reference's beat, a caption swap from the complaint to the share line, countdown voiceover over the music bed, mixed to -14 LUFS.

projects.title: Sunster Self-Tanner: Grey to Golden (Danish)

projects.description: A Danish-language DTC ad for Sunster self-tanner that follows one night from winter-pale to golden: the 22:00 routine, the glow developing overnight, the 07:00 reveal, and a friend asking if she's been on vacation.
projects.hook: “Vinterbleg?” (Winter pale?) “Ingen sol før april… og jeg ligner et spøgelse.” (No sun until April… and I look like a ghost.)
projects.audience: Danish women who feel pale during the long, sunless winter
projects.objective: Show the full routine and believable results, then drive purchases of the self-tanning set.
projects.production: Live-action AI scenes with on-screen clock timestamps, a step-by-step routine (drops in day cream for the face, mousse and mitt for the body, 10 minutes), a skin close-up showing the glow developing over 6–8 hours, and a before-and-after mirror shot.
projects.editing: Danish captions with highlighted keywords, step cards and a progress bar, a before/after split, and social proof on Day 5 (“Har du været på ferie?” – Have you been on vacation?). End card: “Danmarks bedste selvbruner”, Danish Beauty Award 2025 nominee, “Køb sættet nu” (Buy the set now), 45-day risk-free trial.

projects.title: NineOne Car Rental: Snow & Winter (AI Video + Motion Graphics)
projects.concept: A fake live news broadcast. A tita and a kid react to snow on a hot Laguna street, a field reporter goes live, and the reveal lands: “Snow at Winter, nasa Biñan na!” (Snow and Winter are now in Biñan!). The pun is on the cars’ plate names.
projects.description: An AI video with full motion graphics for NineOne Car Rental Services, styled as a Taglish breaking-news report: snow falls in Biñan, Laguna, and the “Snow” and “Winter” turn out to be the two rental cars. It launches the new units and their Christmas rates.
projects.hook: BREAKING: “Nag-snow sa Laguna?!” (It snowed in Laguna?!), followed by the sticker “Teka… snow?!” (Wait… snow?!)
projects.audience: Families and travelers in Laguna and Luzon planning holiday road trips
projects.objective: Introduce two rental units, the Xpander GLS 2026 (plate “SNOW”, 7–8 seats) and the Kia Sonet LX AT (plate “WINTER”, 5–6 seats), show rates by destination, and drive bookings before Christmas.
projects.production: AI-generated scenes: a sunny Filipino street turning snowy, a field reporter in a red jacket, a lolo interview (“Aabot ba ’yan hanggang Baguio?”, Can that make it to Baguio?), and both cars driving through Laguna, beach, rice-field, mountain and pine-road locations.
projects.editing: Motion graphics carry the whole ad: a news-broadcast package (BREAKING and LIVE lower thirds, a scrolling ticker, a REC timecode), pop-in stickers, car callout labels, an animated Luzon route map with a kilometer counter and an “Unlimited Mileage” stamp, a destination progress bar (Laguna → Nearby → North → Tarlac+ → Baguio+), animated rate cards for each region, a “25 days or more” best-deal burst (₱1,950/day Xpander, ₱1,650/day Kia Sonet), falling snow particles, glitch transitions, and a branded end card with the booking number and mascot.
projects.deliverables: 60-second vertical (9:16) Taglish ad for Facebook, TikTok and Reels. CTA: “Limited units ngayong Pasko! Book na!” (Limited units this Christmas, book now!)
